info.title: zmux JSON-RPC Protocol
info.description: Canonical OpenRPC 1.3.2 specification for zmux. Covers all 28 v0.4.0 D1-D6 JSON-RPC methods, 9 server-to-client notifications, 6 error codes, 11 error kinds, and additive v0.5.0 and v0.6.0 extensions.

servers.name: local-unix-socket
servers.summary: Local UNIX domain socket served by zmuxd using newline-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0

socketPath.description: Resolved via override > ZMUX_SOCKET > SMITHERS_SESSION_SOCKET > XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/smithers-sessions.sock > HOME/.smithers/sessions.sock > /tmp/zmux-<uid>/sessions.sock

servers.name: zmux-ws-bridge
servers.summary: Authenticated WebSocket bridge exposed by zmux-ws

methods.name: daemon.ping
methods.summary: Inspect daemon health, version, socket path, and live counters

result.name: ping
result.description: Daemon identity and runtime telemetry counters

methods.name: daemon.shutdown
methods.summary: Request graceful daemon shutdown after acknowledging the caller

methods.name: mux.snapshot
methods.summary: Return the full server-owned multiplexer state tree

result.name: snapshot
result.description: Complete snapshot of sessions, windows, layout trees, panes, clients, and key bindings

methods.name: session.create
methods.summary: Create a new session with an initial window and PTY pane
methods.description: Spawns a PTY child inside a new session. Accepts id, name, or title as the human-readable session name while allocating fresh sessionId, windowId, and paneId identifiers.

result.name: session
result.description: Session info merged with sessionId, windowId, paneId, and generation

methods.name: session.terminate
methods.summary: Terminate a session or pane and clean up its PTY process

methods.name: session.list
methods.summary: List all panes across all sessions with summary metadata

methods.name: session.info
methods.summary: Fetch detailed native PTY state for a single session or pane

methods.name: session.resize
methods.summary: Resize a running session or pane PTY and persist its geometry for respawns

methods.name: session.capture
methods.summary: Capture recent scrollback lines as lossy UTF-8 text and exact base64 bytes

params.name: lines
params.description: Maximum trailing lines to capture from scrollback (default 200)

methods.name: session.send
methods.summary: Write text or raw base64-encoded bytes to a running pane PTY

params.name: text
params.description: UTF-8 text to write when dataBase64 is omitted

params.name: enter
params.description: Append a carriage return after text when dataBase64 is omitted

params.name: dataBase64
params.description: Standard base64-encoded raw bytes to write directly to the PTY

params.name: data_base64
params.description: Snake-case alias for dataBase64

methods.name: session.sendKey
methods.summary: Send a named tmux-style key sequence (Enter, C-c, ArrowUp, F1-F12) to a pane

params.name: key
params.description: Case-insensitive tmux-style key name such as Enter, C-c, Escape, ArrowUp, or F5

methods.name: session.rename
methods.summary: Rename an existing session and return the updated multiplexer snapshot

methods.name: window.new
methods.summary: Create a new window with an initial pane inside an existing session

methods.name: window.select
methods.summary: Select the active window in its owning session

methods.name: window.rename
methods.summary: Rename an existing window

methods.name: pane.split
methods.summary: Split an existing pane horizontally or vertically and spawn a new PTY pane

params.name: axis
params.description: Split axis: horizontal (h, -h) or vertical (v, -v). Defaults to vertical unless horizontal is true.

params.name: horizontal
params.description: Shorthand boolean used when axis is omitted

methods.name: pane.select
methods.summary: Select the active pane inside its window and session

methods.name: pane.rename
methods.summary: Set a pane title and optionally mark it as custom

params.name: custom
params.description: Whether the title was explicitly customized (default true)

methods.name: pane.respawn
methods.summary: Respawn a terminated pane, or replace a running pane when kill is true

params.name: kill
params.description: Terminate a running pane child before respawning. When false, respawning a running pane returns conflict (PaneRunning).

methods.name: client.attach
methods.summary: Attach a logical client to a pane and receive bounded scrollback replay plus live output notifications

params.name: createIfMissing
params.description: Optional session.create parameter object to atomically create a missing target session

params.name: resumeFromOffset
params.description: Exclusive byte offset already received by the client for gap-free replay resumption

params.name: resumeGeneration
params.description: Pane process generation associated with resumeFromOffset

params.name: readOnly
params.description: Attach without allowing input writes or PTY resizes

params.name: resizePolicy
params.description: How this client participates in multi-client PTY geometry resolution

params.name: replayMode
params.description: Select raw scrollback bytes, VT ansi_restore snapshot, or none

methods.name: client.detach
methods.summary: Detach a logical client owned by this or another connection

methods.name: client.switch
methods.summary: Switch an attached logical client to another pane

methods.name: client.list
methods.summary: List all currently attached logical clients

methods.name: events.subscribe
methods.summary: Replace this connection's pane_output subscription list
methods.description: Pass ["*"] to receive pane_output from every pane, a list of pane IDs or session names, or an empty array to unsubscribe.

params.name: panes
params.description: Pane targets to subscribe to, or ["*"] for all panes

methods.name: key.bind
methods.summary: Bind a key in a key table to a zmux command line

params.name: key
params.description: Key identifier to bind

params.name: command
params.description: Command line executed when the binding fires

params.name: cmd
params.description: Alias for command

params.name: table
params.description: Key table name (default prefix)

params.name: repeat
params.description: Whether the binding allows repeated invocation

methods.name: key.dispatch
methods.summary: Dispatch a bound key in the context of a target pane

params.name: key
params.description: Key to look up and dispatch

params.name: table
params.description: Key table name (default prefix)

result.name: dispatchResult
result.description: Returns the updated MuxSnapshot when handled, or { handled: false } when unbound

methods.name: key.list
methods.summary: List all registered key bindings

methods.name: command.exec
methods.summary: Execute a tmux-style command string (split-window, new-window, respawn-pane) against a target pane

params.name: command
params.description: Command line to execute

params.name: line
params.description: Alias for command

methods.name: session.screen
methods.summary: Read structured VT terminal state, rendered plain text, OSC state, modes, and optional cell grid

params.name: includeScrollback
params.description: Number of scrollback lines to include above the visible viewport (default 0)

params.name: includeCells
params.description: Include styled cell matrix for the visible viewport

params.name: includeAnsiRestore
params.description: Include a self-contained ANSI/DEC restore sequence

methods.name: pane.wait
methods.summary: Wait server-side until a pane matches text, exits, becomes idle, or transitions OSC prompt or agent status

params.name: pattern
params.description: Substring or pattern to match in pane output or rendered screen text

params.name: regex
params.description: Treat pattern as a regular expression

params.name: exit
params.description: Resolve when the pane process exits

params.name: idleMs
params.description: Resolve after this many milliseconds with no output

params.name: promptState
params.description: Resolve when OSC 133 prompt state equals this value

params.name: agentStatus
params.description: Resolve when OSC 7501 agent status equals this value

params.name: timeoutMs
params.description: Maximum wait time in milliseconds (default 30000)

methods.name: pane.exec
methods.summary: Run a shell command inside a pane and collect its exit code and bounded output

params.name: command
params.description: Shell command to execute inside the pane

params.name: timeoutMs
params.description: Execution timeout in milliseconds (default 30000)

params.name: captureOutput
params.description: Whether to return captured command output (default true)

methods.name: pane.signal
methods.summary: Deliver a POSIX signal to a pane process or foreground process group

params.name: signal
params.description: POSIX signal name (such as SIGINT or SIGTERM) or positive signal number

params.name: group
params.description: Send to the foreground process group when true (default true)

methods.name: pane.close
methods.summary: Close a single pane and prune its parent window or session if empty

params.name: force
params.description: Force termination even when a foreground job is running

methods.name: window.close
methods.summary: Close a window and terminate all panes inside it

params.name: force
params.description: Force termination of all panes inside the window

methods.name: pane.resizeSplit
methods.summary: Adjust the layout split ratio for a pane's containing split node

params.name: splitId
params.description: Optional explicit split node identifier within the layout tree

params.name: ratio
params.description: Absolute fraction assigned to the first child in [0.05, 0.95]

params.name: delta
params.description: Relative ratio adjustment applied when ratio is omitted

methods.name: pane.zoom
methods.summary: Toggle or explicitly set zoom state for a pane within its window

params.name: zoomed
params.description: Explicit zoom state. Omit to toggle.

methods.name: pane.metadata
methods.summary: Read, merge, replace, or delete arbitrary string metadata key-value pairs on a pane

params.name: set
params.description: Key-value pairs to merge or replace on the pane

params.name: remove
params.description: Keys to delete from the pane metadata map

params.name: replace
params.description: Replace the entire metadata map with set instead of merging

methods.name: pane.record
methods.summary: Start, stop, or inspect an asciicast v2 recording of a pane stream

params.name: action
params.description: Recording control action

params.name: path
params.description: Absolute output file path when action is start

params.name: format
params.description: Recording wire format

params.name: maxBytes
params.description: Optional maximum recording file size in bytes

methods.name: client.setMode
methods.summary: Update read-only status or resize policy for an attached client

params.name: readOnly
params.description: Set whether the client is restricted to read-only observation

params.name: resizePolicy
params.description: Set how the client participates in pane geometry resolution

x-notifications.name: pane_output
x-notifications.summary: Base64-encoded PTY output chunk emitted for attached or subscribed panes

x-notifications.name: pane_output_dropped
x-notifications.summary: Backpressure notice emitted when queued pane_output exceeded the per-connection cap

x-notifications.name: pane_activity
x-notifications.summary: Edge-triggered activity notice emitted when an idle pane produces output

x-notifications.name: pane_bell
x-notifications.summary: Terminal bell (BEL, 0x07) detected in pane PTY output

x-notifications.name: session_exited
x-notifications.summary: Broadcast when a pane child process has exited and its PTY stream has drained

x-notifications.name: foreground_changed
x-notifications.summary: Broadcast when a pane's foreground process group changes

x-notifications.name: pane_respawned
x-notifications.summary: Broadcast after a pane starts a new process generation

x-notifications.name: client_detached
x-notifications.summary: Sent to a client's owning connection when detached remotely or when its target is removed

x-notifications.name: client_switched
x-notifications.summary: Sent to a client's owning connection when another connection switches it to a different pane

x-notifications.name: pane_title_changed
x-notifications.summary: Broadcast when OSC 0 or OSC 2 updates a pane's dynamic title

x-notifications.name: pane_cwd_changed
x-notifications.summary: Broadcast when OSC 7 reports a pane working directory change

x-notifications.name: pane_prompt_changed
x-notifications.summary: Broadcast when OSC 133 shell integration transitions prompt state or records a command exit

x-notifications.name: pane_status_changed
x-notifications.summary: Broadcast when OSC 7501, OSC 9, or OSC 777 updates semantic agent status

SessionId.name: sessionId
SessionId.description: Target session ID, session name, or pane ID

PaneId.name: paneId
PaneId.description: Target pane ID, session ID, or session name

WindowId.name: windowId
WindowId.description: Target window ID or window name

IdAlias.name: id
IdAlias.description: Fallback target identifier alias (or session name on session.create)

Command.name: command
Command.description: Command string passed to the shell

Cwd.name: cwd
Cwd.description: Initial working directory for the PTY child

Env.name: env
Env.description: Environment variables merged over the daemon environment (or replacing it when clearEnv is true)

ClearEnv.name: clearEnv
ClearEnv.description: Replace the daemon environment instead of merging env

ScrollbackBytes.name: scrollbackBytes
ScrollbackBytes.description: Scrollback ring buffer capacity in bytes (1..67108864, default 10485760)

Metadata.name: metadata
Metadata.description: Initial string key-value metadata attached to the new pane
